svg.aria-label: Articles in an overlay: Shows a list of articles in an overlay. Select an article to read its headline and text. One JSON file: Loads the articles from data/articles.json. Fully responsive: Works on every screen width. Few DOM updates: Builds the DOM with fragments, so the browser does few updates. Dynamic ARIA: Sets ARIA attributes dynamically. Debounced hover: Debouncers keep hover from stealing focus
